verses.exactText: In the beginning of God's preparing the heavens and the earth —
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning of God's preparing the heavens and the earth —

verses.exactText: the earth hath existed waste and void, and darkness [is] on the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God fluttering on the face of the waters,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: the earth hath existed waste and void, and darkness [is] on the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God fluttering on the face of the waters,

verses.exactText: and God saith, 'Let light be;' and light is.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and God saith, 'Let light be;' and light is.

verses.exactText: And God seeth the light that [it is] good, and God separateth between the light and the darkness,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God seeth the light that [it is] good, and God separateth between the light and the darkness,

verses.exactText: and God calleth to the light 'Day,' and to the darkness He hath called 'Night;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day one.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and God calleth to the light 'Day,' and to the darkness He hath called 'Night;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day one.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let an expanse be in the midst of the waters, and let it be separating between waters and waters.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let an expanse be in the midst of the waters, and let it be separating between waters and waters.'

verses.exactText: And God maketh the expanse, and it separateth between the waters which [are] under the expanse, and the waters which [are] above the expanse: and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God maketh the expanse, and it separateth between the waters which [are] under the expanse, and the waters which [are] above the expanse: and it is so.

verses.exactText: And God calleth to the expanse 'Heavens;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day second.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God calleth to the expanse 'Heavens;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day second.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let the waters under the heavens be collected unto one place, and let the dry land be seen:' and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let the waters under the heavens be collected unto one place, and let the dry land be seen:' and it is so.

verses.exactText: And God calleth to the dry land 'Earth,' and to the collection of the waters He hath called 'Seas;' and God seeth that [it is] good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God calleth to the dry land 'Earth,' and to the collection of the waters He hath called 'Seas;' and God seeth that [it is] good.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let the earth yield tender grass, herb sowing seed, fruit-tree (whose seed [is] in itself) making fruit after its kind, on the earth:' and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let the earth yield tender grass, herb sowing seed, fruit-tree (whose seed [is] in itself) making fruit after its kind, on the earth:' and it is so.

verses.exactText: And the earth bringeth forth tender grass, herb sowing seed after its kind, and tree making fruit (whose seed [is] in itself) after its kind; and God seeth that [it is] good;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the earth bringeth forth tender grass, herb sowing seed after its kind, and tree making fruit (whose seed [is] in itself) after its kind; and God seeth that [it is] good;

verses.exactText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day third.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day third.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let luminaries be in the expanse of the heavens, to make a separation between the day and the night, then they have been for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let luminaries be in the expanse of the heavens, to make a separation between the day and the night, then they have been for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years,

verses.exactText: and they have been for luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth:' and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and they have been for luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth:' and it is so.

verses.exactText: And God maketh the two great luminaries, the great luminary for the rule of the day, and the small luminary — and the stars — for the rule of the night;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God maketh the two great luminaries, the great luminary for the rule of the day, and the small luminary — and the stars — for the rule of the night;

verses.exactText: and God giveth them in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and God giveth them in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth,

verses.exactText: and to rule over day and over night, and to make a separation between the light and the darkness; and God seeth that [it is] good;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and to rule over day and over night, and to make a separation between the light and the darkness; and God seeth that [it is] good;

verses.exactText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fourth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fourth.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let the waters teem with the teeming living creature, and fowl let fly on the earth on the face of the expanse of the heavens.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let the waters teem with the teeming living creature, and fowl let fly on the earth on the face of the expanse of the heavens.'

verses.exactText: And God prepareth the great monsters, and every living creature that is creeping, which the waters have teemed with, after their kind, and every fowl with wing, after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God prepareth the great monsters, and every living creature that is creeping, which the waters have teemed with, after their kind, and every fowl with wing, after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.

verses.exactText: And God blesseth them, saying, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and the fowl let multiply in the earth:'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God blesseth them, saying, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and the fowl let multiply in the earth:'

verses.exactText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fifth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fifth.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind:' and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind:' and it is so.

verses.exactText: And God maketh the beast of the earth after its kind, and the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God maketh the beast of the earth after its kind, and the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness, and let them rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that is creeping on the earth.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness, and let them rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that is creeping on the earth.'

verses.exactText: And God prepareth the man in His image; in the image of God He prepared him, a male and a female He prepared them.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God prepareth the man in His image; in the image of God He prepared him, a male and a female He prepared them.

verses.exactText: And God blesseth them, and God saith to them, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over every living thing that is creeping upon the earth.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God blesseth them, and God saith to them, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over every living thing that is creeping upon the earth.'

verses.exactText: And God saith, 'Lo, I have given to you every herb sowing seed, which [is] upon the face of all the earth, and every tree in which [is] the fruit of a tree sowing seed, to you it is for food;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God saith, 'Lo, I have given to you every herb sowing seed, which [is] upon the face of all the earth, and every tree in which [is] the fruit of a tree sowing seed, to you it is for food;

verses.exactText: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the heavens, and to every creeping thing on the earth, in which [is] breath of life, every green herb [is] for food:' and it is so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the heavens, and to every creeping thing on the earth, in which [is] breath of life, every green herb [is] for food:' and it is so.

verses.exactText: And God seeth all that He hath done, and lo, very good; and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day the sixth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And God seeth all that He hath done, and lo, very good; and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day the sixth.

verses.exactText: A Psalm of David. Jehovah [is] my shepherd, I do not lack,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A Psalm of David. Jehovah [is] my shepherd, I do not lack,

verses.exactText: In pastures of tender grass He causeth me to lie down, By quiet waters He doth lead me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In pastures of tender grass He causeth me to lie down, By quiet waters He doth lead me.

verses.exactText: My soul He refresheth, He leadeth me in paths of righteousness, For His name's sake,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: My soul He refresheth, He leadeth me in paths of righteousness, For His name's sake,

verses.exactText: Also — when I walk in a valley of death-shade, I fear no evil, for Thou [art] with me, Thy rod and Thy staff — they comfort me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Also — when I walk in a valley of death-shade, I fear no evil, for Thou [art] with me, Thy rod and Thy staff — they comfort me.

verses.exactText: Thou arrangest before me a table, Over-against my adversaries, Thou hast anointed with oil my head, My cup is full!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Thou arrangest before me a table, Over-against my adversaries, Thou hast anointed with oil my head, My cup is full!

verses.exactText: Only — goodness and kindness pursue me, All the days of my life, And my dwelling [is] in the house of Jehovah, For a length of days!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Only — goodness and kindness pursue me, All the days of my life, And my dwelling [is] in the house of Jehovah, For a length of days!

verses.exactText: To everything — a season, and a time to every delight under the heavens:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: To everything — a season, and a time to every delight under the heavens:

verses.exactText: A time to bring forth, And a time to die. A time to plant, And a time to eradicate the planted.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to bring forth, And a time to die. A time to plant, And a time to eradicate the planted.

verses.exactText: A time to slay, And a time to heal, A time to break down, And a time to build up.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to slay, And a time to heal, A time to break down, And a time to build up.

verses.exactText: A time to weep, And a time to laugh. A time to mourn, And a time to skip.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to weep, And a time to laugh. A time to mourn, And a time to skip.

verses.exactText: A time to cast away stones, And a time to heap up stones. A time to embrace, And a time to be far from embracing.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to cast away stones, And a time to heap up stones. A time to embrace, And a time to be far from embracing.

verses.exactText: A time to seek, And a time to destroy. A time to keep, And a time to cast away.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to seek, And a time to destroy. A time to keep, And a time to cast away.

verses.exactText: A time to rend, And a time to sew. A time to be silent, And a time to speak.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to rend, And a time to sew. A time to be silent, And a time to speak.

verses.exactText: A time to love, And a time to hate. A time of war, And a time of peace.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: A time to love, And a time to hate. A time of war, And a time of peace.

verses.exactText: What advantage hath the doer in that which he is labouring at?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: What advantage hath the doer in that which he is labouring at?

verses.exactText: I have seen the travail that God hath given to the sons of man to be humbled by it.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have seen the travail that God hath given to the sons of man to be humbled by it.

verses.exactText: The whole He hath made beautiful in its season; also, that knowledge He hath put in their heart without which man findeth not out the work that God hath done from the beginning even unto the end.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The whole He hath made beautiful in its season; also, that knowledge He hath put in their heart without which man findeth not out the work that God hath done from the beginning even unto the end.

verses.exactText: I have known that there is no good for them except to rejoice and to do good during their life,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have known that there is no good for them except to rejoice and to do good during their life,

verses.exactText: yea, even every man who eateth and hath drunk and seen good by all his labour, it [is] a gift of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: yea, even every man who eateth and hath drunk and seen good by all his labour, it [is] a gift of God.

verses.exactText: I have known that all that God doth is to the age, to it nothing is to be added, and from it nothing is to be withdrawn; and God hath wrought that they do fear before Him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have known that all that God doth is to the age, to it nothing is to be added, and from it nothing is to be withdrawn; and God hath wrought that they do fear before Him.

verses.exactText: What is that which hath been? already it is, and that which [is] to be hath already been, and God requireth that which is pursued.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: What is that which hath been? already it is, and that which [is] to be hath already been, and God requireth that which is pursued.

verses.exactText: And again, I have seen under the sun the place of judgment — there [is] the wicked; and the place of righteousness — there [is] the wicked.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And again, I have seen under the sun the place of judgment — there [is] the wicked; and the place of righteousness — there [is] the wicked.

verses.exactText: I said in my heart, 'The righteous and the wicked doth God judge, for a time [is] to every matter and for every work there.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart, 'The righteous and the wicked doth God judge, for a time [is] to every matter and for every work there.'

verses.exactText: I said in my heart concerning the matter of the sons of man that God might cleanse them, so as to see that they themselves [are] beasts.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart concerning the matter of the sons of man that God might cleanse them, so as to see that they themselves [are] beasts.

verses.exactText: For an event [is to] the sons of man, and an event [is to] the beasts, even one event [is] to them; as the death of this, so [is] the death of that; and one spirit [is] to all, and the advantage of man above the beast is nothing, for the whole [is] vanity.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For an event [is to] the sons of man, and an event [is to] the beasts, even one event [is] to them; as the death of this, so [is] the death of that; and one spirit [is] to all, and the advantage of man above the beast is nothing, for the whole [is] vanity.

verses.exactText: The whole are going unto one place, the whole have been from the dust, and the whole are turning back unto the dust.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The whole are going unto one place, the whole have been from the dust, and the whole are turning back unto the dust.

verses.exactText: Who knoweth the spirit of the sons of man that is going up on high, and the spirit of the beast that is going down below to the earth?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Who knoweth the spirit of the sons of man that is going up on high, and the spirit of the beast that is going down below to the earth?

verses.exactText: And I have seen that there is nothing better than that man rejoice in his works, for it [is] his portion; for who doth bring him in to look on that which is after him?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And I have seen that there is nothing better than that man rejoice in his works, for it [is] his portion; for who doth bring him in to look on that which is after him?

verses.exactText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God;

verses.exactText: this one was in the beginning with God;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: this one was in the beginning with God;

verses.exactText: all things through him did happen, and without him happened not even one thing that hath happened.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: all things through him did happen, and without him happened not even one thing that hath happened.

verses.exactText: In him was life, and the life was the light of men,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In him was life, and the life was the light of men,

verses.exactText: and the light in the darkness did shine, and the darkness did not perceive it.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and the light in the darkness did shine, and the darkness did not perceive it.

verses.exactText: There came a man — having been sent from God — whose name [is] John,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There came a man — having been sent from God — whose name [is] John,

verses.exactText: this one came for testimony, that he might testify about the Light, that all might believe through him;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: this one came for testimony, that he might testify about the Light, that all might believe through him;

verses.exactText: that one was not the Light, but — that he might testify about the Light.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: that one was not the Light, but — that he might testify about the Light.

verses.exactText: He was the true Light, which doth enlighten every man, coming to the world;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He was the true Light, which doth enlighten every man, coming to the world;

verses.exactText: in the world he was, and the world through him was made, and the world did not know him:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: in the world he was, and the world through him was made, and the world did not know him:

verses.exactText: to his own things he came, and his own people did not receive him;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: to his own things he came, and his own people did not receive him;

verses.exactText: but as many as did receive him to them he gave authority to become sons of God — to those believing in his name,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: but as many as did receive him to them he gave authority to become sons of God — to those believing in his name,

verses.exactText: who — not of blood nor of a will of flesh, nor of a will of man but — of God were begotten.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: who — not of blood nor of a will of flesh, nor of a will of man but — of God were begotten.

verses.exactText: And the Word became flesh, and did tabernacle among us, and we beheld his glory, glory as of an only begotten of a father, full of grace and truth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And the Word became flesh, and did tabernacle among us, and we beheld his glory, glory as of an only begotten of a father, full of grace and truth.

verses.exactText: John doth testify concerning him, and hath cried, saying, 'This was he of whom I said, He who after me is coming, hath come before me, for he was before me;'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John doth testify concerning him, and hath cried, saying, 'This was he of whom I said, He who after me is coming, hath come before me, for he was before me;'

verses.exactText: and out of his fulness did we all receive, and grace over-against grace;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and out of his fulness did we all receive, and grace over-against grace;

verses.exactText: for the law through Moses was given, the grace and the truth through Jesus Christ did come;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: for the law through Moses was given, the grace and the truth through Jesus Christ did come;

verses.exactText: God no one hath ever seen; the only begotten Son, who is on the bosom of the Father — he did declare.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God no one hath ever seen; the only begotten Son, who is on the bosom of the Father — he did declare.

verses.exactText: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent out of Jerusalem priests and Levites, that they might question him, 'Who art thou?'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent out of Jerusalem priests and Levites, that they might question him, 'Who art thou?'

verses.exactText: and he confessed and did not deny, and confessed — 'I am not the Christ.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and he confessed and did not deny, and confessed — 'I am not the Christ.'

verses.exactText: And they questioned him, 'What then? Elijah art thou?' and he saith, 'I am not.' — 'The prophet art thou?' and he answered, 'No.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And they questioned him, 'What then? Elijah art thou?' and he saith, 'I am not.' — 'The prophet art thou?' and he answered, 'No.'

verses.exactText: They said then to him, 'Who art thou, that we may give an answer to those sending us? what dost thou say concerning thyself?'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: They said then to him, 'Who art thou, that we may give an answer to those sending us? what dost thou say concerning thyself?'

verses.exactText: He said, 'I [am] a voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He said, 'I [am] a voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.'

verses.exactText: And those sent were of the Pharisees,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And those sent were of the Pharisees,

verses.exactText: and they questioned him and said to him, 'Why, then, dost thou baptize, if thou art not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and they questioned him and said to him, 'Why, then, dost thou baptize, if thou art not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?'

verses.exactText: John answered them, saying, 'I baptize with water, but in midst of you he hath stood whom ye have not known, this one it is who is coming after me, who hath been before me,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John answered them, saying, 'I baptize with water, but in midst of you he hath stood whom ye have not known, this one it is who is coming after me, who hath been before me,

verses.exactText: of whom I am not worthy that I may loose the cord of his sandal.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: of whom I am not worthy that I may loose the cord of his sandal.'

verses.exactText: These things came to pass in Bethabara, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: These things came to pass in Bethabara, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing,

verses.exactText: on the morrow John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God, who is taking away the sin of the world;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: on the morrow John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God, who is taking away the sin of the world;

verses.exactText: this is he concerning whom I said, After me doth come a man, who hath come before me, because he was before me:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: this is he concerning whom I said, After me doth come a man, who hath come before me, because he was before me:

verses.exactText: and I knew him not, but, that he might be manifested to Israel, because of this I came with the water baptizing.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and I knew him not, but, that he might be manifested to Israel, because of this I came with the water baptizing.

verses.exactText: And John testified, saying — 'I have seen the Spirit coming down, as a dove, out of heaven, and it remained on him;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And John testified, saying — 'I have seen the Spirit coming down, as a dove, out of heaven, and it remained on him;

verses.exactText: and I did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, He said to me, On whomsoever thou mayest see the Spirit coming down, and remaining on him, this is he who is baptizing with the Holy Spirit;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and I did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, He said to me, On whomsoever thou mayest see the Spirit coming down, and remaining on him, this is he who is baptizing with the Holy Spirit;

verses.exactText: and I have seen, and have testified, that this is the Son of God.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and I have seen, and have testified, that this is the Son of God.'

verses.exactText: On the morrow, again, John was standing, and two of his disciples,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: On the morrow, again, John was standing, and two of his disciples,

verses.exactText: and having looked on Jesus walking, he saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God;'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and having looked on Jesus walking, he saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God;'

verses.exactText: and the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.

verses.exactText: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'

verses.exactText: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.

verses.exactText: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who heard from John, and followed him;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who heard from John, and followed him;

verses.exactText: this one doth first find his own brother Simon, and saith to him, 'We have found the Messiah,' (which is, being interpreted, The Anointed,)
verses.normalizedComparisonText: this one doth first find his own brother Simon, and saith to him, 'We have found the Messiah,' (which is, being interpreted, The Anointed,)

verses.exactText: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)

verses.exactText: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, 'Be following me.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, 'Be following me.'

verses.exactText: And Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: And Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter;

verses.exactText: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith to him, 'Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets, we have found, Jesus the son of Joseph, who [is] from Nazareth;'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith to him, 'Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets, we have found, Jesus the son of Joseph, who [is] from Nazareth;'

verses.exactText: and Nathanael said to him, 'Out of Nazareth is any good thing able to be?' Philip said to him, 'Come and see.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and Nathanael said to him, 'Out of Nazareth is any good thing able to be?' Philip said to him, 'Come and see.'

verses.exactText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'

verses.exactText: Nathanael saith to him, 'Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, 'Before Philip's calling thee — thou being under the fig-tree — I saw thee.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael saith to him, 'Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, 'Before Philip's calling thee — thou being under the fig-tree — I saw thee.'

verses.exactText: Nathanael answered and saith to him, 'Rabbi, thou art the Son of God, thou art the king of Israel.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael answered and saith to him, 'Rabbi, thou art the Son of God, thou art the king of Israel.'

verses.exactText: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'

verses.exactText: and he saith to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and he saith to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'
